sourceSequence.operation: copy the complete original main executable into a temporary file
replace the bundle-type token in the main executable before packaging
run NSIS bundling against the patched main executable
truncate and restore the original main executable after bundling

conclusion.verifiedMechanism: Default NSIS bundling embeds a patched executable, then restores the loose source executable. Comparing the installed executable with the restored source SHA256 uses the wrong reference bytes.
conclusion.limitation: The historical artifact contains the installer and reports, but no loose source executable, installed-file digest or generated installer.nsi. This analysis proves the bundler mechanism and inspects the actual package payload; it does not claim that every historical source/installed byte difference was compared or that only three bytes differed. The two NSS occurrences must not be blindly reverse-patched.
